detail.longDescription: I can't be the only person who types a question into Google, opens 12 tabs from the results, and somehow still can't find a straight answer. Google AI Mode is here to save me, specifically, from that tab chaos. AI Mode is a conversational Google Search experience powered by Gemini. It breaks questions into related searches, combines what it finds into an AI-generated response, and includes web links you can use to check the answer or dig deeper.
